question: Which selected native command forms an army, and does it establish a safe first-capital Archer army grant?

scope.boundary: Selected command-name cells, one dispatch arm, the complete selected eligibility and formation functions, the adjacent function that clears a field and creates units, and selected CityCreate frame and first-capital words. An incidental eight-word prefix before CityCreate entry supplies no semantic claim. Unit creation, killing, indirect callback bodies, native marker persistence and network delivery are not expanded.

dependencies.use: Accepted command-name mapper and the link to the native command-record type.
Accepted dispatcher table: type 10 selects 0x82CE026C and type 11 selects 0x82CE02A0; numeric command identity does not prove delivery.
Limited-scope qualifications for the non-specialized creator, and qualifications for the founding origin and lifetime.
Previously accepted nonzero live-unit+0x4 army-name selector.

commandIdentity.label: MakeArmy
commandIdentity.nativeJoin: Cell 0x82CD5448 is mapper index 10 and contains 0x82CD55AC; lis and addi at 0x82CD55AC and 0x82CD55B0 return 0x82156C3C. Accepted dispatcher type 10 reaches 0x82CE026C. The code at 0x82CE026C and 0x82CE0270 supplies the preserved unit and player as r4 and r3, and 0x82CE0274 calls 0x82D13618. The later arm clears unit+0xC bit 0x10000 before the shared tail.
commandIdentity.adjacentOwner: Type 11 instead calls 0x82D13520 at 0x82CE02A8. That function clears the selected unit+0x4 at 0x82D13550 and loops twice over non-specialized unit creation plus copied state and a virtual callback. It is not the selected MakeArmy producer.

eligibility.inputs: r3=p,r4=j; U=0x830F2BF0+84*(256*p+j). Native callers must supply a valid owner and slot, and readable records that stay valid.
eligibility.earlyGates: 0x82D008F8..0900 rejects nonzero U+0x4.0x82D00918..0934 rejects definition+0x50 intersecting0x8081.0x82D00938..094C rejects the current Barbarian ordinal and UnitType7. If U16[0x8314F1C8] is nonzero,0x82D00964..0970 requires p equal to NativeLocalPlayer0x82D8A3A0; the flag's broader meaning is unassigned.
eligibility.matchingRecords: The four-way unrolled loop 0x82D0098C..0x82D00B24 scans 256 records in p's pool. It counts records with owner byte != 255, clear unit+0xC sign bit, matching X and Y at +0x1C and +0x1E, matching type +0x1 and zero army selector +0x4. The selected unit is not excluded from this count.
eligibility.return: 0x82D00BD4..0x82D00BE8 returns 1 for count >= 3, otherwise 0, under the normal ABI, where preserved registers stay unchanged. Local-player paths can issue virtual+0x80 notifications before that return, including a count 2 path; the eligibility helper is not generally side-effect-free.

formation.admission: Entry retains p and j;0x82D1362C calls eligibility0x82D008D0. Zero returns before formation writes at0x82D13638/3C.
formation.memberSelection: The loop 0x82D136B4..0x82D13890 scans ascending slots 0..255 in p's pool. It skips owner 255, unit+0xC sign-bit records, selected j, coordinate or type mismatch, nonzero army selector and matches after two were selected. For each of the first two matches it combines state and calls UnitKill 0x82D02390(p,member,0) at 0x82D1387C. No explicit member-ID arguments or per-kill success checks exist in this selected function.
formation.combinedState: Selected rank+0x5 contributes to a sum; special-upgrade words+0x10 are ORed, halfwords+0x52 are ANDed, and signed halfword+0x36 plus signed movement byte+0x2 use maxima. The definition flag0x10 path conditionally retargets carrier links+0x26 from the consumed slot to j before killing it.
formation.survivor: 0x82D13894..0x82D138CC writes selected U+0x4=1; rank+0x5=1 or 2 when the combined rank exceeds 3; selected movement, upgrade and two halfword results are written back. 0x82D138E0 sets selected U+0x22=-1. The selected slot j survives this local scan; transitive callbacks have their own separate lifetime conditions.
formation.refresh: This function invokes frontend virtual+0x1B8(p,j) at 0x82D138EC, then virtual+0x1C0(6) only for a local player, then virtual+0x1BC(p,j) at 0x82D1395C. 0x82D13968 calls recount 0x82D11AD8(1,1), and 0x82D1396C returns 1. Actual callback targets, model or stat effect and what stays unchanged through transitive calls are not established by those slot numbers.

grantBoundary.result: A selected native formation producer is bound. Merely setting U+0x4 does not reproduce its eligibility, two-member consumption, state composition, carrier repair, callbacks or recount.
grantBoundary.existingUnits: Calling it on three newly created Archers does not guarantee only those new units are consumed: an earlier matching ordinary Archer on the same tile can be one of the first two matches. A grant must protect existing units without guessing a native exclusion or relocation contract.
grantBoundary.remaining: First-capital event receipt and persistence, frozen option and save policy, allocation failure recovery, actual callback targets, confirmation that the survivor and its state keep their identity and value, Archer eligibility in the reached state, and multiplayer execution and delivery remain required before a safe configurable grant is accepted.

scopedInterventionBoundary.cityInvocation: CityCreate 0x82D18D88 saves the caller state, allocates 0x180 bytes at 0x82D18D94, saves entry X and Y at frame+0x19C and +0x1A4 and preserves the entry owner in r20 at 0x82D18DC4. Reuse the accepted r16 city-index, success-tail and two founding-origin contract, while revalidating semantic current owner C+0 rather than assigning current-owner meaning to initial C+1 equality.
scopedInterventionBoundary.firstCapitalMarker: 0x82D19CD8..CE0 requires the selected owner city-count word to be zero; 0x82D19CE4..CEC excludes the current Barbarian. 0x82D19CFC..D08 tests the owner bit in 0x830E5144; the clear arm stores the combined history word at 0x82D19D14 and sets selected city+0x10 bit 0 at 0x82D19D20. The marker store is before the final successful return; reaching it alone is not a successful city result or a durable grant receipt.
scopedInterventionBoundary.formationFrame: 0x82D13620 allocates 0xF0 bytes; the owner, selected slot and candidate ordinal are preserved in r19, r26, r28. 0x82D136B4 is the first candidate-record read, before candidate matching, state composition or killing.
scopedInterventionBoundary.skipDestination: 0x82D13884 increments candidate r28; 0x82D13888 advances the record cursor by 0x54 and 0x82D1388C..90 loops while candidate < 256. A jump from 0x82D136B4 to 0x82D13884 that is taken only when a condition holds therefore excludes one candidate without writing its record, while keeping the ordinary increment and selected-state accumulators.
scopedInterventionBoundary.requirements: Any filter added in the title code must be scoped to the exact formation invocation and validate the intended fresh member identities. Eligibility counts all native matching records, so a narrowed member set needs independent proof of three eligible new units before entry and two actual retirements afterward. The native formation tail does not verify its selected-member count again before setting the army selector. Whether the selected survivor and its state keep their identity and value through callbacks, and failure cleanup, remain separate conditions.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only Ghidra words from the supported image, fixed four-byte PowerPC decoding and exact headers and end bounds of the generated functions. All emitted words matched the pinned flat image. No generated EOF body or setup body was read. The scoped-intervention follow-up emitted 132 words across two already selected/native CityCreate functions.

generated:rerevved/sub_82D008D0:identified complete owner header and following header; selected final return/notification window only

guards: Native names and static calls establish this selected command path, not natural AI invocation, authority, completed delivery or runtime success.
Keep the caller's owner and slot limits, supported readable record and definition extents, normal ABI register preservation and absence of external mutation explicit.
Do not replace formed-army semantics with three independent units, one flag write or the adjacent function that clears a field and creates units.
Do not use the selected member scan to consume pre-existing units as an unqualified extra-unit grant.
falsification: Different mapper cells, branch words, matching predicates or survivor writes falsify the selected native route. Executed Archer creation and formation and callback lifetime evidence could extend the grant boundary; a name display alone cannot.
conclusion: Native command 10 MakeArmy reaches 0x82D13618, which requires eligibility, consumes two selected units of the same type on the same tile and updates the survivor through callbacks and recount. This closes the formation-producer identity question, but not a safe first-capital Archer army grant.
